objective: Make a slice build PR carry its own Reconciliation, so the ORBIT pane shows progress when the PR merges. Guard against lost statuses from concurrent slice PRs.
why: The pane reads only Reconciliations merged on dev. Today progress waits days for a separate records PR. The owner chose progress at merge on 2026-10-13. Naqid found the lost-status risk, so the guard is part of this slice.

include: The orbit skill steps for a Reconciliation in a slice PR
Lint rules: raised status needs evidence that names a path in the PR diff
Lint rule: no change to a criterion outside contributesTo against the newest Reconciliation on dev
A CI workflow that runs the records lint on PRs that change docs/orbit
A warning, not a block, when a slice PR changes a status with no Reconciliation
The dev merge-base and PR number in the Reconciliation; /orbit status finds the squash commit by PR number
Getting the initiative from the slice record, not from the branch name
An AgDR that amends AgDR-0225 option I
Tests for each lint rule, including two concurrent slice PRs
exclude: Merge gates that read ORBIT records (Build with ORBIT ac2-4 stays)
Rex reading ORBIT records outside the PR diff
